custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the metal plate. Real loupes often have brand names (e.g., Belomo, Zeiss) or magnification power (e.g., 10x, 20x). If the text is nonsensical glyphs, this is a strong AI artifact. Also, verify if the double-lens appearance is structurally sound for a triplet loupe or if it looks like two separate objects fused together.
